## Read survey data in excel

```{r}

source("C:/CodigoR/WCS-CameraTrap/R/organiza_datos_v3.R")


data_oso_tatama <- read_excel("C:/CodigoR/Occu_APs/Occu_APs_blog/posts/Tatama/data/ResultadosTatama.xlsx")


Cuadricula_muestreo <- read_sf("C:/CodigoR/Occu_APs/shp/Tatama/CeldasMuestreo.shp") |>
  mutate (ID=SCid) |> 
  filter(Nucleo=="Tatama")

muestreadas_Tatama <- Cuadricula_muestreo |> left_join(data_oso_tatama, by ="ID")

Tatama_NP <- read_sf("C:/CodigoR/Occu_APs/shp/Tatama/WDPA_WDOECM_Jul2025_Public_13966_shp-polygons.shp")

Oso_stack <- read_excel("C:/CodigoR/Occu_APs/Occu_APs_blog/posts/Tatama/data/ResultadosTatama.xlsx", 
    sheet = "Oso-Stack") |> 
  mutate(In_AP=factor(In_AP)) |> 
  mutate(obs1=as.numeric(obs1)) |> 
  mutate(obs2=as.numeric(obs2)) |> 
  mutate(obs3=as.numeric(obs3)) |> 
  mutate(year_factor=as.factor(year))
  
 # make a map
 mapview (Tatama_NP, alpha=0.5) + 
   mapview (Cuadricula_muestreo, color = "green", col.regions = "green", alpha = 0.5) # +
   #mapview (AP_Tahuayo, color = "green", col.regions = "green", alpha = 0.5) +
#   mapview (covs_Bol_Madidi_sites, zcol = "in_AP", col.regions =c("red","blue"), burst = TRUE) 
#   # mapview (covs_Ecu_17_sites, zcol = "in_AP", col.regions 


```

```{r}

library(unmarked)
library(ubms)

umf_stack <- unmarkedFrameOccu(y=Oso_stack[,2:4], 
                               siteCovs=Oso_stack[,c(1,5,6,7,8)],
                         # obsCovs=list(date=date_stack[,1:3])
                         )
head(umf_stack)

fit_stack1 <- stan_occu(~scale(year) ~In_AP + (1|ID), 
                       data=umf_stack, chains=3, iter=500)

fit_stack1b <- stan_occu(~1 ~In_AP + (1|ID), 
                       data=umf_stack, 
                       chains=3, 
                       iter=5000)

# fit_stack2 <- stan_occu(~scale(year) ~scale(Dist_AP) + (1|ID), 
#                       data=umf_stack, chains=3, iter=500)

# fit_stack3 <- stan_occu(~scale(year) ~In_AP + scale(Dist_AP) + (1|ID), 
#                       data=umf_stack, chains=3, iter=500)

fit_stack4 <- stan_occu(~1 ~ year_factor + (1|ID), 
                       data=umf_stack, chains=3, iter=500)

fit_stack1



ran1 <- ranef(fit_stack1, submodel="state")
pred1 <- predict(fit_stack1, submodel="state") 
colnames(pred1) <- c("Predicted", "SD", "lower", "upper")
# compare dentro fuera
prediction1 <- cbind(Oso_stack[,c(1,5,6,7,8)], pred1) |>
  group_by(In_AP) |> 
  summarise_at(c("Predicted", "lower", "upper"), 
               mean, na.rm = TRUE)

# head(ran$ID[[1]])

ran4 <- ranef(fit_stack4, submodel="state", summary=TRUE)
# head(ran$ID[[1]])

ubms::plot_effects(fit_stack1, "state") # dentro fuera
ubms::plot_effects(fit_stack4, "state") # compare years

```

```{r}
prediction1 <- cbind(Oso_stack[,c(1,5,6,7,8)], pred1) |>
  group_by(In_AP) |> 
  summarise_at(c("Predicted", "lower", "upper"), 
               mean, na.rm = TRUE)
DT::datatable(prediction1)
```
